answer: Beacon-ordered work tickets set each applicant’s proof target from a verifiable randomness beacon after nonce commitment, so no umber-hued forecast precomputes it. Admission needs one valid proof before the next round, costing fresh expected hash work plus a deposit forfeited on duplicate tickets; a nectar-selling hobbyist pays the same per-identity price as a farm. Unpredictable targets keep mass registration linear, so a sparrow-sized honest batch cannot reuse work to subsidize a larger one.
